data_objects.name: consumer_credit_records
data_objects.meaning: Individual consumer credit records combining financial, demographic, and account attributes.
data_objects.notes: A serialized row index is present, but no source business identifier is included.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Serialized record index from an earlier table representation.

variables.name: Income
variables.meaning: Income amount associated with the consumer record.

variables.name: Limit
variables.meaning: Credit limit associated with the account or consumer.

variables.name: Cards
variables.meaning: Number of credit cards associated with the consumer.

variables.name: Education
variables.meaning: Amount of education encoded as a numeric duration.

variables.name: Balance
variables.meaning: Credit-account balance associated with the record.

structure.description: Each row represents one consumer or credit-account record; Unnamed: 0 functions as a row index rather than a domain identifier.
Gender and Ethnicity are categorical labels, Student and Married are Yes/No encodings, and Cards, Age, and Education are count or duration fields.

uncertainties: The currency and scale of Income, Limit, and Balance are not stated, and the time basis of Income is unspecified.
The credit-rating scale and whether a row represents a person, account, or application snapshot are not defined.
The source definitions and collection conventions for demographic categories are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv table was used as evidence.
